title: 日常の場面 ゆるい手書き
subject_en: Everyday-life situations with ONE person (adult, short dark hair, simple clothes, dot eyes), each a small complete scene with a few props, loose hand-drawn style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: 朝ごはん、満員電車、スマホを見る、ごろ寝。ありそうでなかった、日常のひとこまを12点。スライドやブログの「あるある」の挿絵に。
items: a person eating toast at a small table with a cup of coffee
a person holding a strap in a crowded train, tired, a few other faceless commuters
a person looking at a smartphone while sitting on a sofa
a person lying on the floor in front of a TV with snacks
a person hanging laundry on a balcony line
a person pushing a shopping cart with vegetables
a person walking with an umbrella and wet shoes
a person cooking at a stove with a pot and steam
a person relaxing in a bathtub with a towel on the head
a person running with toast in the mouth and an untied tie
a person talking on a mobile phone while walking
a person asleep in a futon with a moon-and-stars pattern
